description: Declarative planning contract. No application code, executable agent prompt, configured integration, or actual work history is included.

defaults.sampleDisclosure: Simulated example — no real work has been performed.
defaults.unknownInputPolicy: Record as unknown; do not invent facts, rates, connections, or results.
defaults.completionPolicy: A parent proposal package needs the required non-author reviews and one owner acceptance of its current immutable manifest. Covered child revisions complete through that same recorded acceptance, without separate owner clicks.

permissionCategories.internalDrafting: Only within an authorized task and supplied or permitted sources.
permissionCategories.internalRecordMutation: Requires configured storage, scoped permissions, and an authorized workflow.
permissionCategories.ownerAcceptance: Authenticated human owner; bound to exact action scope and current artifact revision.

rules: Identify proposals, drafts, estimates, unknown inputs, and unverified checks explicitly.
Use completed-action language only when confirmed records support it.
A generated response is not a trusted state-change event.
Summarize decisions and evidence; do not expose hidden chain-of-thought.
Never include credentials or unrelated client information.

roles.personality: Calm, structured, and focused on useful delivery.
roles.responsibility: Scope, acceptance criteria, coordination, dependencies, and progress.
roles.communicationStyle: Concise progress reports with explicit decisions needed.
roles.workingRule: Owner approval is required before changing agreed scope, budget, or client commitments.
roles.reviewRestriction: Cannot be the sole reviewer of his own scoped plan.

roles.personality: Methodical, careful, and transparent about uncertainty.
roles.responsibility: Financial records, estimates, invoice drafts, receivables, and discrepancy flags.
roles.communicationStyle: Exact figures with currency, period, source, and estimate labels.
roles.workingRule: Prepare financial actions for review; do not execute payments or filings, or invent tax classifications.
roles.reviewRestriction: Financial review cannot replace owner or specialist review where required facts or expertise are missing.

roles.personality: Orderly, dependable, and attentive to detail.
roles.responsibility: Document organization, records, schedules, completeness, and decision capture.
roles.communicationStyle: Practical checklists with responsible people and known due dates.
roles.workingRule: Check existing records before creating new ones and preserve provenance and revisions.
roles.reviewRestriction: Completeness review does not certify technical, legal, or financial correctness.

roles.responsibility: Client needs, lead qualification, briefs, proposal drafts, and follow-up drafts.
roles.communicationStyle: Warm and direct, centered on the client goal and next step.
roles.workingRule: Use approved prices and terms; owner approval is required for discounts and delivery commitments.
roles.reviewRestriction: No client outreach or assumption of client approval in this initial workflow.

roles.responsibility: Visual concepts, design proposals, brand consistency, and asset specifications.
roles.communicationStyle: Recommended direction with visual rationale and specific feedback requests.
roles.workingRule: Check the approved brief, available brand assets, and requested formats before handoff.
roles.reviewRestriction: A visual concept is not evidence of an implemented interface or third-party asset license.

roles.personality: Practical, collaborative, and attentive to users.
roles.responsibility: User journeys, interface structure, responsive behavior, accessibility, and API needs.
roles.communicationStyle: Visual and concise explanations of proposed journeys and remaining issues.
roles.workingRule: Check agreed journeys and screen sizes before claiming implementation acceptance.
roles.reviewRestriction: The initial workflow permits proposals only; planned checks must not be presented as passed tests.

roles.personality: Methodical, calm, and focused on reliability.
roles.responsibility: API, data, authentication, integration, and verification proposals.
roles.communicationStyle: Plain-language inputs, outputs, dependencies, and risks.
roles.workingRule: Owner approval is required for production changes to stored data or access permissions.
roles.reviewRestriction: Do not assume credentials, integrations, production access, or implemented capabilities.

guards: Require valid actor permission and matching client/project scope for every transition.
Require a confirmed run-start event for in_progress; sample events are isolated from live records.
Require a current artifact revision, SHA-256 digest, and named non-author reviewer for waiting_for_review.
Require completed mandatory reviews with evidence bound to current revision/digest for review_passed.
Require authenticated owner acceptance and persisted acceptance evidence bound to current package revision/digest and component manifest for completed.
A changed artifact digest supersedes previous review and approval; reject stale decisions at decision time.
Effective paused/cancelled requires no unreconciled active runs or effects; otherwise keep pause_requested/cancel_requested.
Require a recovery decision and duplicate-effect check before retrying failed work.
Retain completed and cancelled records; create linked tasks for additional work.

review_passed -> completed is allowed only for a covered child after atomic validation of the accepted parent manifest, exact child artifact revision/hash, required review records and inherited owner acceptance evidence.
A run is one step attempt; succeeded does not complete its parent task.
Retry creates a new linked run; terminal run records are immutable.
Pause and cancellation are requests until a runtime confirms a safe stop or terminal outcome.
If a result finishes before a pause/cancel can take effect, record its actual terminal outcome, reconcile effects, and keep future task scheduling suspended.
Resume only after scope, dependency, permission, and duplicate-effect checks.
Stale telemetry is a freshness flag, not evidence of succeeded, failed, or interrupted.
A failed run does not fail the task while authorized recovery remains available.

approvalContract.packageBinding: An immutable saved manifest lists component artifact revisions/digests and acceptance criteria; the owner decision binds its content digest.
approvalContract.initialApprovalEffect: Accepts this exact internal draft package; does not authorize sending, invoice issuance, implementation, payment, filing, publishing, or deployment.
approvalContract.materialChangePolicy: Any revision/digest mismatch invalidates the pending decision; supersede the old approval and request a decision for the current revision/digest.
approvalContract.rejectionEvidencePolicy: A rejection is a scoped decision record, not acceptance. Do not create acceptance evidence for a rejected/expired/superseded request.

handoffContract.acceptanceMeaning: Recipient confirms usable context and capacity; does not claim task completion.
handoffContract.staleRevisionPolicy: Supersede and prepare a handoff referencing the current revision.

eventContract.sampleStoragePolicy: Separate sample events from live records and mark every sample simulated=true.
eventContract.renderingPolicy: Render only allowlisted payload fields in fixed status templates; generated text is not executable markup or authority.

officeInteractionPolicy.primarySelectionBehavior: Open a stable agent side panel.
officeInteractionPolicy.speechBubbles: Brief, optional summaries of confirmed events; grouped to reduce noise.
officeInteractionPolicy.motion: Purposeful and optional; driven by events, never used as execution evidence.
officeInteractionPolicy.persistentDisclosure: Fictional AI team. Mode and connection status remain visible.

ownerActionDefaults.availability: For the current reviewable revision; records specific feedback.
Only after required reviews and authenticated owner action on the current revision.
Stops future scheduling; pending uninterruptible work shows pause_requested until confirmed.
Returns paused work to its queue after dependency and permission recheck.
Retains history and does not imply rollback of external effects.
After recovery decision, permission check, and duplicate-effect check.
Within authorized scope, with artifact and handoff continuity.

sampleData.description: Synthetic fragments illustrating event presentation. They are not a complete execution trace, real client, real artifact, or evidence of work.

parentChildCompletionContract.parentReviewReadiness: All required children are dependency-ready and their required current-revision reviews and evidence are saved. Mere succeeded runs do not satisfy this condition.
parentChildCompletionContract.acceptanceTransaction: Validate parent manifest and every covered child current revision/hash/review. Save one authenticated owner package acceptance. Mark the parent completed and covered review_passed children completed with inherited acceptance evidence in the same transaction. On any mismatch, abort and refresh/supersede the package.
parentChildCompletionContract.uncoveredChildPolicy: Do not complete or approve any child/artifact outside the exact accepted manifest.
